name: Lost in Space Cosmic Rides
summary:
Step aboard and surrender to the stars.
This is not a game you play  it's a ride you experience. From the moment you take your seat, your spacecraft takes control, carrying you on a stunning 15-minute cinematic voyage across the universe. No buttons. No objectives. Just pure, jaw-dropping spectacle in every direction.
